## Appearance

George is a black cat. He appears in this form following the departure of Mr. Meredith.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P39](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0039), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012)_

## Personality

George is regarded as a thoroughly pleasant individual. Despite his good-natured demeanor, he possesses a penchant for mischief and is reputed to have a fondness for drink.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## History

Before sailing on the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), George was engaged to a girl at home and spent time visiting his Uncle Abner alongside his cousin, [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md). When [Dick](../character/dick.md) fell ill in Cuba, George stayed behind to nurse him, but a striking resemblance between the two cousins ultimately caused a years-long mix-up regarding their identities. After undergoing an operation, George regained his memory and was subsequently taken back home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) by his sister.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P30](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0030), [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001), [v3 ch.Interlude P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004), [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Interlude P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006), +94 more_

## Relationships

### [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anthony-pye--george.md)

George is Anthony Pye's uncle. Their familial connection establishes a direct blood relationship between the two.

- Relative of — uncle and nephew  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george--gilbert-blythe.md)

George is related to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as an uncle by marriage to Gilbert's aunt. While they share this extended family connection, their shared history is primarily tied to the revelation of George's true identity, which altered the lives of those in Gilbert's circle.

- Relative of — uncle by marriage to Gilbert's aunt  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>

### [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george--pacifique.md)

George holds an authoritative position over [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md). He commands [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), establishing a dynamic where [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) acts under his instruction.

- Commands  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>

### [Dick](../character/dick.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--george.md)

George and [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) are double cousins who shared a striking physical resemblance. This extraordinary likeness led to a years-long identity mix-up following an injury, which was only resolved after George underwent an operation that restored his memory and allowed his sister to take him back home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

- Relative of — double cousins (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011)</sub>
